posts.title: Payback Period Is the Metric That Kept Us Honest
posts.description: Lifetime value tells you what a customer might be worth someday. Payback period tells you whether you will still be in business when someday arrives.

posts.title: Bloat Takes the Experts Away From the Work
posts.description: As companies grow, the reflex is to add layers and narrow jobs. The quiet cost is that the people who know the business best drift furthest from it.

posts.title: Nobody Majors in Transformation
posts.description: There is no degree for this work, no major you can declare, and the people who are good at it almost always backed into it sideways the way I did.
